item.title: The Song of Ribhu - translated
item.description:
The Song of Ribhu Translated from the original Tamil by Dr. H. Ramamoorthy and Nome

Source: TW

Author: Dr. H. Ramamoorthy and Nome

Purchase ‘The Song of Ribhu’ from the Society of Abidance in Truth .

(Alternatively from Amazon.com or Amazon.co.uk)

Ramana Maharshi often recommended the Ribhu Gita to seekers who visited him. This was read aloud many evenings at Ramanasramam

Chapter 10 - All is of the Nature of the Self

Hear this exposition about the greatness of the Self.
That is peaceful and the rare quintessence.
The Self, which is not insentient, which is One,
And which is Existence-Consciousness-Bliss, is all pervasive.
That Self is itself. There is nothing apart from the Self.
The pot and the cloth and others
That are seen as manifold
All are of the nature of the Self.
